page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture and provides 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high resource density with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers a highly consolidated platform for enterprise-grade workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This configuration is suitable for large-scale general-purpose applications, enterprise databases, high-traffic web serving, and containerized microservices architectures that require significant parallel processing capabilities and substantial memory capacity.
